name: detection-engineering
description: Use this skill when the user says 'write a Sigma rule', 'Splunk SPL query', 'KQL hunting', 'detect LOLBins', 'alert tuning', 'detection as code'. Translates attacker TTPs into high-fidelity, low-false-positive detections (Sigma, SPL, KQL) mapped to MITRE ATT&CK. Defensive only. Do NOT use for: incident response/forensics (use security/blueteam-operations), SIEM platform architecture (use security/siem-engineering), or SOAR playbooks (use security/soar-automation).
